visual.name: orgConstellation
visual.description: An organisation shown as a constellation of people clustered by location or team, and as an org chart. Search, team highlight, lasso selection and cross-filtering.

dataRoles.name: personId
dataRoles.description: One row per person or open role

dataRoles.name: managerId
dataRoles.description: The manager's Person ID; blank at the top of the org

dataRoles.name: group
dataRoles.description: The team inside a department (for example Platform). Names the clusters and boxes.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: 'On leave' and 'Open role' are drawn differently

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: Shows how long someone has been with the company in the tooltip

dataRoles.name: size
dataRoles.description: Dot size, for example annual cost

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Yearly budget for the position; shown for open roles
